relationships.subject: Tet1-LNP (morphine)
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI mice treated with Tet1-LNP (morphine) experienced prolonged analgesia for nearly 32 h compared with 3 h with free morphine

relationships.subject: Tet1-LNP (morphine)
relationships.evidence_quote: the brain morphine concentration in the Tet1-LNP (morphine) group was eight-fold lower than that in the morphine group

key_findings: Neural-targeting Tet1 lipid nanoparticles deliver morphine to DRG, giving ~32 h analgesia in CCI mice versus 3 h for free morphine.
Brain morphine concentration was eight-fold lower with Tet1-LNP (morphine).
